column7: structural half of low-severity-full-row-save-001..004 (#2700): asserts all four new LocalStorage bodies are Where+Updates with no Save and no Select("*"), and that the three core entry points route through them. All three full-row primitives (UpdateRotationPolicy, UpdateSecretTemplate, UpdateWebAuthnCredential) are DELETED in this PR -- unlike #2695/#2698, where one caller each belonged to another open PR and a no-remaining-caller sweep was needed instead -- so the guard names them as forbidden purely so re-adding one goes red rather than producing an unrelated build error. Runs without a Postgres DSN
